title: NetworkConsentCheckResult
description: network.consent-check-result@1 (L24): the answer to network.consent-check-request@1. Every subject asked about is in allowed: true only for an active choice that covers the purpose, the kind, the app and the feature asked about. An unknown or deleted subject is false, the same as a person who never chose (the answer never says whether an account exists). A service caches an answer for at most 60 s and drops it on network.consent.changed; when Network cannot answer, every subject is false.

allowed.description: Each subject asked about, and whether the use is allowed for them.

licence.description: data.public only: the licence each allowed subject chose.
